source.title: Categorical Torelli theorems: results and open problems

accepted.question_text: Let X1 and X2 be smooth projective varieties over a field, belonging to the same deformation class, and let Ku(X1) and Ku(X2) denote their Kuznetsov components, i.e. the geometrically meaningful residual admissible subcategories appearing after exceptional objects are removed from Db(X1) and Db(X2). Is X1 isomorphic to X2 if and only if Ku(X1) and Ku(X2) are equivalent as categories?

accepted.question_text: Let X be a complete intersection of one cubic hypersurface and two quadric hypersurfaces in P^6. trace.notes: Input was the zbMATH URL https://zbmath.org/7716009. Direct shell fetch failed because DNS is unavailable in the sandbox, so web search was used for identifier-specific recovery. Search results connected the record to Zbl 07716009, the article title, DOI 10.1007/s12215-022-00796-x, and the open-access Springer full HTML source.

Mapped the Springer HTML source. Major relevant regions are the introduction with the categorical and birational categorical Torelli problems, Section 2 on Fourier-Mukai functors, Section 3 on Kuznetsov components for Enriques surfaces, cubic threefolds and cubic fourfolds, Section 5 on stability conditions and Bogomolov inequalities, Section 6 on cubic threefolds and prime Fano threefolds, and Section 7 on cubic fourfolds and Gushel-Mukai fourfolds.
Extracted the general Categorical Torelli problem and Birational Categorical Torelli problem from the introduction.
Extracted Questions 2.7 and 2.8 concerning Fourier-Mukai type functors and equivalences for admissible subcategories.

Extracted Enriques, cubic threefold, and cubic fourfold Kuznetsov-component questions. Question 3.5 was moved to needs_review because the gathered evidence preserved only an unresolved reference to Theorem 3.4.
Extracted Question 5.12 and Conjecture 5.13 on Bogomolov-type inequalities and existence of stability conditions.
Extracted questions on cubic threefold extension techniques, Serre-invariant stability conditions, Veronese double cones, Gushel-Mukai threefolds, and quartic threefolds.
Extracted cubic fourfold and Gushel-Mukai fourfold questions, including an explicitly resolved Hodge-isometry subquestion and the Gushel-Mukai birational conjecture.

Rewrote accepted candidates into self-contained statements by inlining the variety class, categorical objects, relevant equivalence type, and the target conclusion when the source gave enough local context.

Question 3.5 was not rewritten into an accepted item because its wording depends on Theorem 3.4 and the three preceding families; the local evidence captured in this run did not include enough theorem text to restate it without guessing.

Kept distinct categorical Torelli, birational categorical Torelli, Fourier-Mukai representability, stability-condition, and Bogomolov-inequality problems separate. Split the two subquestions in Question 6.36 into separate categorical and birational quartic-threefold items.

Accepted items have source locators and verbatim snippets, avoid source-pointing language in question_text, and do not rely on abstract-only or metadata-only records. q_026 was routed to needs_review because of an unresolved cross-reference.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/7716009.json and outputs/latest.json.
